image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a tiger beetle on a sandy, pebbled surface. The beetle has a metallic coppery-bronze exoskeleton with distinct pale cream-colored markings on its elytra. It features large compound eyes, long filiform antennae, and visible slender legs.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Head broader than pronotum with large prominent compound eyes.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head is clearly visible, appearing wider than the thorax segment behind it, and the large, bulging compound eyes are prominent and correctly positioned.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Long sickle-shaped mandibles adapted for capturing prey.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The mandibles are visible at the front of the head, appearing elongated and curved inward (sickle-like), consistent with the species' predatory anatomy.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Filiform antennae extending well beyond the midbody.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Both antennae are clearly visible, thread-like (filiform), and extend significantly past the middle of the body length.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Elongated, slender body with distinctly narrow proportions.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The overall body shape is elongated and relatively narrow, fitting the description of a cursorial beetle.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Bright metallic coloration in green, bronze, or copper tones.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The exoskeleton exhibits a strong metallic sheen with dominant copper/bronze hues, matching the taxonomic description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Distinctive pale markings on smooth iridescent elytra.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The wing covers (elytra) show clear, irregular pale/cream markings against the metallic background, and the surface appears smooth and iridescent.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Six slender cursorial legs enabling rapid pursuit.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: All six legs are visible (three on each side). They appear slender and jointed, consistent with arthropod anatomy.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Chitinous exoskeleton with segmented body (head, thorax, abdomen).
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The three main body segments (head, thorax, abdomen/elytra) are distinct and properly connected, with a texture suggesting a hard chitinous shell.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific species identification and rule out look-alike beetles or generic insect generations.
To ensure the thin, complex structures of the legs and antennae do not merge with the background or the body (common AI artifact).
To verify the metallic iridescence is physically consistent and not just a flat texture map or noisy pattern.

focus_areas: Metallic reflection consistency on curved surfaces
Background sand grain interaction with feet
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the tips of the antennae and the tarsi (feet) of the legs. AI often blurs these fine details into the background. Verify if the metallic sheen follows the curvature of the elytra logically or if it looks like a static overlay.
